summary: VERVE Fitness is a Gold Coast (Upper Coomera) home and commercial gym equipment brand, running Shopify with NetSuite and several buy-now-pay-later gateways, and planning a US launch in 2027. Natasha Saunders joined as Financial Controller in July 2025 after years as Group Financial Controller at Sliqpay. VERVE is also advertising an AI and automation specialist to automate finance workflows.

hooks.text: New controller on NetSuite with Shopify and several BNPL and card gateways, with a US launch ahead: payout and multi-entity reconciliation load is about to grow.
Import-heavy model: PO, PI and bill matching and container costs feed the ledger.
VERVE is already looking at automating finance workflows, so the timing for a purpose-built tool is live.

risks.text: VERVE is hiring an in-house automation specialist for finance workflows (possible build-vs-buy competitor); NetSuite is the ledger so Vert must complement it.

gaps: No posts by Natasha about VERVE's close found.
No press coverage of finance operations found.
Only LinkedIn confirms headcount (25 vs 36 in account notes).

first.subject: Payout reconciling at VERVE with NetSuite
first.body:
Hi Natasha,

Saw you joined VERVE as Financial Controller last July after years as Group Financial Controller at Sliqpay. With NetSuite behind the store, payouts from Afterpay, Zip and Stripe, and a US launch planned for 2027 I'd guess month-end reconciling is growing quickly. I've spent the past year asking finance leaders why AI automation in accounting sticks or quietly fails. That became Vert, which reconciles and cash codes 2x faster and works alongside NetSuite rather than replacing it. How much of your close is payout and gateway matching today?

Best,
Dawoud
